title: 목적 말하기: -(으)러 가다/오다
note: Made by the daily run on 2026-09-26 at three pages; read back by hand (checked identical to the English PDF) and shortened by hand.

manual.before: Use V-(으)러 with 가다, 오다 or 다니다 to say why you are going or coming somewhere. Learn how the form changes for different verb stems and how to avoid three common mistakes.
manual.after: Say why you are going or coming somewhere with V-(으)러 가다/오다/다니다.
manual.why: Fixed spacing (찾으러 왔어요) and a shorter summary/objective — the Indonesian edition ran to three pages.

manual.before: Learners can say why they are going or coming somewhere with V-(으)러 가다/오다/다니다. They can build the right form for vowel stems (보러), consonant stems (먹으러), ㄹ-stems (만들러, 놀러), ㄷ-irregular stems (들으러) and ㅂ-irregular stems (도우러). They can also fix three common errors: using it before a verb that is not 가다/오다/다니다 (*공부하러 도서관에서 앉아요), putting 가다/오다 in front of -러 (*가러 가요), and using it with adjectives (*예쁘러 가요).
manual.after: Say why you go or come somewhere with V-(으)러 가다/오다/다니다, build the right form for every kind of verb stem, and avoid three common mistakes.
manual.why: Fixed spacing (찾으러 왔어요) and a shorter summary/objective — the Indonesian edition ran to three pages.
